source_text: The Ashley Montagu Resolution asserts that non-therapeutic genital mutilations of children, encompassing both female genital cutting and male circumcision, constitute violations of fundamental human rights by inflicting permanent physical harm without consent, thereby infringing on the child's right to bodily integrity and security of person. [2]
